welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.description: Welcome to Neptuno. This live environment runs from the ISO — nothing is installed yet.

features.title: What's in it?
features.description: A niri desktop on a bootc image. Test apps, commands and workflows before you commit.

community.title: Where are the docs?
community.description: Documentation lives with the repo and the Universal Blue docs. File issues when something breaks.

developer.title: Updates
developer.description: Updates ship as OCI images — rollback and rebasing are first-class bootc operations.

completed.title: Ready when you are
completed.description: Create your user, pick a disk, and install. When it's done, reboot into Neptuno.
